title: Milk Came From Cold Wire, Yet Baby Monkeys Clung to Soft Cloth 17 Hours a Day
description:
You think babies bond with parents just to get milk! Yet soft cloth beat the milk bottle every single day! This is the true story of Harry Harlow's Cloth Mother Study. Here is what went wrong with old parenting rules.
